entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to start a return for an order. My order number is VF88602.
Okay, VF88602. I see it here. This is for the VeloFit Pro-Lite Road Cycling Shoes. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with them?

They just don't fit right. I've taken them on a couple of rides, and I'm getting terrible blisters on my heels. I've tried different socks, but these specific cycling shoes just aren't working for my foot shape.

I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Let me just check your delivery date. It looks like you received these 25 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, perfect. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the shoes back in the original box and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll process your full refund.

That's great news, I appreciate it. One more question. Since I had a poor experience and had to mount and then remove my cleats, which was a bit of a hassle, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I still want to buy a different pair from you.

I understand the request, and I'm glad to hear you're sticking with VeloFit. While I can't offer a discount on top of the full refund for the return, I can definitely point you toward our sizing guide and some wider-fit models that might prevent any future issues. We want to make sure your next pair is a perfect match.
Alright, that's fair. The refund is the most important part. I see the email with the label now. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
